alive.last_commit_message:
Show subproject chats as one Core-paged list, without empty folders (#1137)

* Read chats across a project's linked children in one Core page

GET /api/v1/chat/projects/{id}/linked-chats returns one bounded page of
chats owned by the project's direct child projects, with each chat's
activity state. Chats needing the operator come first, then running chats,
then the rest by recent activity; the order is applied before paging so an
active chat is never left on a later page. Children without chats add
nothing. The API worker and the single-process app share the route.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Show subproject chats as one list in the parent sidebar

The parent conversation list mounted a section for every linked child and
read each child's full chat list and activity, so thousands of chat-less
children produced thousands of empty 'No saved chats' folders and two
requests each. It now renders one Subprojects list from the Core page,
reads it only while the list is visible, and shows nothing when no child
has chats. The parent's 'No conversations match' message is shown again
when nothing in either list matches.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
